name: CE_EXTERNAL_RECON_INT
description: This table is an interface table used to load grouping of bank statement lines and system transactions for bank statement reconciliation in the application.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_RECON_REFERENCE
columns.description: Stores the external reconciliation reference stamped by user.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of bank account associated with the record.

columns.name: RECON_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of the item.  For example, bank statement lines, payable transactions, and receivable transactions.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bank statement line or system transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Supplementary identifier of the record from a source like Oracle Fusion General Ledger that uses composite keys.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the current processing status of the record.

columns.name: PROCESS_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message associated with the processing error.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
